title: Test-run registration refused (HTTP 500) when the persist fence misses its fixed 5 s deadline under build load
outcome: A valid focused or full run is not refused because the background persist worker is briefly slow. Registration durability either waits within a budget that tolerates normal gate and build load, or it reports a typed, retryable refusal that names the cause instead of a bare HTTP 500.
acceptance: The cause of the 06:57Z refusal is identified and recorded on this item: persist-worker latency, state size, or another named cause.

A regression shows that a registration whose persist fence completes after a short delay inside the allowed budget is accepted, and that a fence which truly fails yields a typed, retryable refusal naming registration durability rather than a generic 500.
The launcher reports that refusal so the operator can tell a host durability refusal apart from a test failure.
